_about: Order 14 LPV, V1 (owner, 17 Nov 2026): a rule is asked of a paper only when the thing its own words are about fits the paper's equipment, never because it shares a word with a field. Read by app/rule_subject_fit.py.

Each entry is a construction, a material class or a part that only SOME equipment has. A rule whose OWN SCOPE (its sentence, plus the sentence that introduces its list when it is a list item) names one of an entry's words is about that thing; it is not asked of a paper that names none of the entry's words on any page (every page must be readable as text, or the rule is asked).

Generic: no standard, clause, document or layout is named. A word here must name the thing itself, never a property or a field ('design life', 'pressure'). Engineer-editable data: add a line, no code change.
A thing named only after a negation ('other than', 'except', 'excluding', 'non-') does not count; any doubt asks the rule.
